title: Free-trial auto-renewal refund (EU)
summary: EU variant: a free trial converted to paid without the clear, express consent EU law requires — request a full refund.
goal_default: Please refund the charge in full and cancel the plan.

rights.claim: For a distance contract by electronic means, the trader must make the obligation to pay clear and obtain your express acknowledgement; without it you are not bound by the contract or charge.
Hiding or obscuring that a trial converts to a paid plan can be a misleading commercial practice.

ladder: Refund request citing the Consumer Rights Directive
National consumer authority / European Consumer Centre
